name: il-rulespec-2026-09-29
description: Israel tax-benefit pilot, contributions increment, for supervised RuleSpec-IL encoding of an employee's two payroll deductions: every section- and schedule-level provision that the captured he.wikisource.org OpenLaw pages render for four instruments. Three are the 2026-09-06 pilot captures, byte-identical to release il-rulespec-2026-09-06 (same files, same sha256; every row's body, heading, labels, dates and metadata unchanged, only the version-bound ids and snapshot paths differ): the Income Tax Ordinance [New Version] (Knesset IsraelLawID 2000944), the National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version] 5755-1995 (2000198), and the Economic Efficiency Law (Legislative Amendments for Achieving the Budget Targets for the 2026 Budget Year) 5786-2026 (2242332). The fourth is new: the National Health Insurance Law 5754-1994 (2000111), captured in the same 2026-09-06 session, whose section 14 sets the employee's health-insurance rates (5.17% in 14(b)(1), and 3.23% in 14(f1) on the part of income not above the reduced amount fixed under National Insurance Law section 341). Its second schedule is divided into parts whose items restart at 1, so those items sit under their part (schedule-2/sign-1/item-1, schedule-2/sign-2/item-1); its section 1 follows the table of contents directly; and its sections 62 to 66 amend five other laws and, like seven sections of the amending act, keep no text of their own because OpenLaw prints it inside the laws they amend (metadata.text_merged_into), so release validation reports those rows, and the five merged amending-act sections that also lack a heading, as ten empty_provision_text warnings. Checked 2026-09-29 against the OpenLaw source markup: section 14 is unchanged since the capture, and the one later edit (2026-09-09) touched sections 3 and 28, which this capture predates. That is a reconciliation of a capture, not the complete statute as administered: 1,633 rows against 1,633 source-inventory entries, 0 missing and 0 extra. The provision text is an OpenLaw consolidation, not an official gazette text; the Ordinance is consolidation-knesset-linked and the other three instruments consolidation-wikisource, and every row carries its own tier. It carries statute text only: no regulations and no Tax Authority or National Insurance Institute amount publications, so the reduced collection bracket and the maximum insurable income for a given year remain outside it. Everything release il-rulespec-2026-09-06 says about the pilot captures holds here unchanged, including the Ordinance's hash-pinned supplement for sections 235-247, the seven merged sections of the amending act, and the carried-through ITO section 187 transcription defect.
